data.title: Dunning notice for returned direct debit – November membership fee
data.summary: MusterFit Studios GmbH informs Tobias Beispiel that the direct debit for the November 2025 membership fee (39.90 EUR) was returned by the bank and charges a 7.50 EUR dunning fee, requesting payment of the total 47.40 EUR by 12.12.2025.
data.explanation: Your gym's bank could not collect the November membership fee by direct debit, so it bounced back. The gym is now charging you the original fee plus a 7.50 EUR fee for the failed collection, totaling 47.40 EUR. Please pay this amount by the date shown in the letter to avoid further reminders or fees. If you already paid or the debit went through after this letter was sent, you can disregard it, as the letter itself states. If you're unsure why the debit failed (e.g. insufficient funds or a changed account), check with your bank.
